name: ISL Core Vocabulary
source: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC) Standard

signs.label: HELLO
signs.description: Dominant open hand placed near forehead/temple and arced smoothly outward in greeting.

signs.label: GOODBYE
signs.description: Open hand raised at chest level oscillating side to side.

signs.label: THANK_YOU
signs.description: Flat open hand touching chin/mouth, moving gently outward toward person.

signs.label: PLEASE
signs.description: Open flat palm gently rubbing in a circular motion on the chest.

signs.label: SORRY
signs.description: Closed fist gently rotating over the heart/chest area.

signs.label: HELP
signs.description: Non-dominant flat palm facing up; dominant fist with thumb upright placed on palm and lifted together.

signs.label: YES
signs.description: Fist held upright and tilted forward/downward in an affirmative nod.

signs.label: NO
signs.description: Index and middle fingers snapping or pressing against the thumb horizontally.

signs.label: WATER
signs.description: Hand forming a 'W' or cup shape tapping gently at the corner of the mouth/chin.

signs.label: FOOD
signs.description: Flattened O-shape hand brought repeatedly near the mouth.

signs.label: I
signs.description: Index finger pointing directly at the center of the chest.

signs.label: YOU
signs.description: Index finger pointing forward directly toward conversational partner/camera.

signs.label: MY
signs.description: Open flat palm placed gently flat on the center of the chest.

signs.label: WHAT
signs.description: Both open hands held out with palms facing upward, shaking gently side to side.

signs.label: WHERE
signs.description: Index finger pointed upward, wagging gently left to right in an inquiring motion.
